text.content:
"I LOVE KILLING GANGERS." The nicest man in MaxTac, mostly.

Role: Solo (Solo 7), MaxTac trooper
Affiliation: MaxTac; the Static Night crew
Where to find them: MAX-TAC HQ, Wellsprings; Vista del Rey, where he grew up
Status: A full-body borg: a Raven Microcyb Gemini for the street, a MaxTac Beta Frame for heavy ops
Known for: Talking cyberpsychos down, unless they wear colors

An Old Combat Zone ganger turned cop by an NCPD program, and one of the city's legendary cops of 2045. In 2047 Max Hammerman's people picked the giant patrolman for the Static Night crew because he'd do what he was told and couldn't be bought, and gave him and Contender a MaxTac squad to run alongside it. He worked all four nights of the Purge-Riot, got a commendation for "riot control" that hangs framed over his bed, and a transfer to MaxTac that Contender signed himself.

Off duty he wears a Raven Gemini body that passes for a large, cheerful man with a bad shoulder; on heavy ops he switches to a Beta Frame with his motto stenciled across the chest plate. Kids in Vista del Rey can tell which body he's in from a block away. Loud, kind and enormous, he is MaxTac's best at talking a cyberpsycho down before anyone has to shoot. He has no mercy for anyone in gang colors: colors are a choice, he says.

He wrote the reputation chapter of Sable's rulebook, and is still mad that NetWatch took the credit for 2047.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 04, 10
